newsitem.title: JAPAN: EU's Fischler urges closer Japan-EU ties at WTO.
newsitem.headline: EU's Fischler urges closer Japan-EU ties at WTO.

text.p: European Union Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Tuesday that the EU and Japan should establish a closer alliance on agriculture for the next round of World Trade Organisation (WTO) talks.
"I want to establish a closer alliance between the EU and Japan on how to handle agriculture in the forthcoming WTO talks," Fischler told reporters.
"We'll be obliged to open our agricultural market further and lower domestic farm prices and cut export subsidies. We share the same objectives regarding agriculture," he said.
Fischler said the EU and Japan should cooperate in key agricultural areas including domestic price supports and market access.

Fischler and other European business executives are in Japan this week for talks with senior Japanese government officials, including Agriculture Minister Takao Fujimoto, and to attend an international food exhibition being held in Makuhari, Chiba Prefecture, east of Tokyo.
